title: Panel Ghost Interaction Mode
description: When UI interaction starts in a panel, active element stays visible, rest dims to 5% opacity, panel becomes click-through to canvas.
summary: Refined automatic panel ghosting so nested dimmed UI controls in side panels and window options do not trigger global hiding. Canvas/content drags and direct tree-row interactions retain ghost behavior, including tree ancestry visibility. Added helper and GhostProvider regression coverage for sliders and window options. Focused Nx tests pass (4 relevant tests), ui-react lint passes, and the live Forms fixture kept both windows populated with no data-ghost state while the Height Factor slider value changed; browser console reported no errors.
